# agentic-design

Accessible design tokens and UI primitives for calm, minimal apps.

Keywords: design-system,tokens,ui,accessibility,wcag,react,components,minimal,dark-mode.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-design".
- CLI: agentic-design summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-design mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-design
